Eidelman Virant Capital Sells 11,225 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Alanna Baker | Jan 17th, 2019
Eidelman Virant Capital reduced its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 33.2% during the third quarter, Holdings Channel reports. The institutional investor owned 22,564 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 11,225 shares during the period. Apple comprises approximately 2.5% of Eidelman Virant Capital’s portfolio, making the stock its 13th largest holding. Eidelman Virant Capital’s holdings in Apple were worth $5,093,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Other institutional investors have also bought and sold shares of the company. Peavine Capital LLC increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 4.2% in the 3rd quarter. Peavine Capital LLC now owns 7,260 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,639,000 after acquiring an additional 292 shares during the period. MERIAN GLOBAL INVESTORS UK Ltd increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 3.5% in the 3rd quarter. MERIAN GLOBAL INVESTORS UK Ltd now owns 1,061,659 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $239,658,000 after acquiring an additional 36,321 shares during the period. Intercontinental Wealth Advisors LLC increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 13.6% in the 3rd quarter. Intercontinental Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 9,398 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,122,000 after acquiring an additional 1,128 shares during the period. Willow Creek Wealth Management Inc. increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 12.3% in the 3rd quarter. Willow Creek Wealth Management Inc. now owns 13,167 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,972,000 after acquiring an additional 1,444 shares during the period. Finally, Adams Asset Advisors LLC increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 3.5% in the 3rd quarter. Adams Asset Advisors LLC now owns 66,386 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $14,985,000 after acquiring an additional 2,219 shares during the period. Institutional investors own 57.04% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
In other news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 8,940 shares in the company, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is accessible through the SEC website . Company insiders own 0.05% of the company’s stock.
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $154.94 on Thursday. Apple Inc. has a twelve month low of $142.00 and a twelve month high of $233.47. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a current ratio of 1.12 and a quick ratio of 1.09. The stock has a market cap of $737.27 billion, a PE ratio of 13.01, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.42 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter last year, the firm posted $2.07 EPS. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. Equities research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 12.1 earnings per share for the current year.
A number of analysts recently weighed in on the stock. UBS Group reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Monday. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reissued a “buy” rating and set a $228.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, January 11th. HSBC cut shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and lowered their target price for the company from $200.00 to $160.00 in a research note on Wednesday, January 9th. Daiwa Capital Markets set a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, January 4th. Finally, ValuEngine cut shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research note on Friday, January 4th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-six have given a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock currently has an average rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $195.19. Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
